instruction: Look up the side effects of Amoxicillin.

metadata.explanation: Variation of the original Tamiflu task. User needs to search for Amoxicillin (a common antibiotic) and navigate to its side effects page. The task maintains the same complexity level as the original - single navigation to drugs.com side effects page. Reuses existing getters (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metrics (is_expected_url_pattern_match). Expected URLs follow the same pattern as the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and adds the goto_prefix, returning a URL string

Metric logic is correct: check_amoxicillin_url__b070486d correctly handles the rules parameter (when expected.type='rule', the framework passes config['rules'] directly), extracts URL from result, and uses regex matching against expected patterns
Expected values are semantically correct: Two valid regex patterns match drugs.com Amoxicillin side effects pages (main page with #side-effects anchor and dedicated sfx page)
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies the instruction requirement by checking if user navigated to correct Amoxicillin side effects URL on drugs.com
Runtime feasibility: Getter can extract URL state, metric can perform regex pattern matching, expected patterns are valid and match actual drugs.com URL structure
